readerAnswers.scope: The boundary is narrower than “AI is banned in school.”
readerAnswers.decision: They may not use it for grading, behavior monitoring, placement, promotion, graduation or other decisions about students.
readerAnswers.review: Privacy approval therefore does not prove a pilot improves learning or is free of bias.
readerAnswers.route: the guidance names the school principal as the contact

terms.generative AI: creates text, images, audio or other content from instructions

explainBack: The policy separates who uses AI and which decision it touches: younger students cannot directly use generative AI, while staff planning can be allowed but AI grading and placement cannot.
unseenTransfer: For another school tool labelled approved, ask whether the review covered privacy, bias or learning value; one passing category does not establish the others.
